title: Library

deleteLibrary.confirmDescEmpty: This permanently deletes the library "{{name}}". This action cannot be undone

add.label: Scan for new files
add.desc: Discover and register new media files, then scrape pending ones

indexOnly.label: Scan without scraping
indexOnly.desc: Only register new files; no scrape. Entries that already have metadata are linked without re-scraping

remove.label: Remove dead entries
remove.desc: Delete records for files that no longer exist on disk

scrapeOverride.title: Scrape with number
scrapeOverride.contentTypeHint: Leave empty to infer from the number you enter

batch.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_one: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media file? This action cannot be undone
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_other: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone

detail.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this media file? This action cannot be undone

autoOrganize.label: Auto organize
autoOrganize.hint: Organize the file automatically once it is scraped
autoOrganize.forcedHint: Watch directory is enabled, so files are always organized after scraping

ingest.label: File discovery
ingest.hint: Webhook requires a CloudDrive2 membership; performs better than watching the mount path
ingest.cloudPathHint: Path of this library inside CloudDrive2

fieldTrailerPatternHint: Matches are treated as trailers and skipped during scan and watch
fieldBlacklistPatternsHint: One regex per line; matches are treated as unwanted files and listed as cleanup candidates
fieldMinFileSizeHint: Videos smaller than this are treated as unwanted files and listed as cleanup candidates
fieldCopyResourcesHint: Copy downloaded resources to the library path when organizing
fieldVideoTemplateHint: Relative or absolute path; see placeholder badges below
fieldLinkTemplateHint: Organize creates an STRM file or symbolic link here. Must be an absolute path outside the library
fieldStrmContentTemplateHint: Applies when the link mode is STRM. Default writes the video file absolute path

placeholders.label: Placeholders
placeholders.addCustomHint: A custom placeholder is filled by matching the file name: it takes the text when the original file name or its folder contains it, otherwise it is empty. Wrap it in [ ] to make it appear only when present.
placeholders.customNameHint: Referenced as {name} in templates; letters, digits and underscores only, and it cannot start with a digit
placeholders.customNameInvalid: Use a valid name: start with a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores
placeholders.customLiteral: Text to match in the file name
placeholders.customLiteralHint: Must appear contiguously and must not touch letters. Example: name SONE-638-LTX matches LTX
placeholders.customPreview: {{name}} resolves to {{literal}} when the file name contains {{literal}}, otherwise empty
placeholders.customHint: Filled when the file name contains {{literal}}

items.raw_prefix: Catalog prefix preserving original letter case. e.g. LancelotStylesEvolution.26.10.16 → LancelotStylesEvolution
items.suffix: Catalog number without the prefix. e.g. MIDV-123 → 123
items.title: Title
items.ext: File extension (no dot). Subtitle template uses that subtitle's extension
items.raw_name: Source video filename. e.g. A/B.mp4 → B
items.raw_dir: Source parent directory name. e.g. A/B/C.mp4 → B
items.raw_relpath: Source file path relative to the library root (includes filename and extension). e.g. /lib/A/B.mp4 → A/B.mp4
items.mosaic?: Mosaic nature: censored / uncensored / cracked / leaked / LTX
items.video_dir: Directory of the rendered video. Link and sidecar templates
items.video_name: Rendered video filename (no extension). Link and sidecar templates
items.video_relpath: Rendered video path relative to the library root. Link, sidecar, and STRM content templates
items.link_dir: Directory of the link; same as {video_dir} when the link template is unset
items.link_name: Rendered link filename (no extension); same as {video_name} when the link template is unset
items.raw_srt_name: Source subtitle filename. e.g. A/foo.zh.srt → foo.zh
items.actors_cn: All actors, comma separated, Chinese mapping

cleanup.tooltip: Clean up unwanted files, leftover folders and empty folders
cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.truncated: Too many files; only part of the results are included
cleanup.skipped: {{dirs}} folders and {{files}} files were not covered
cleanup.confirmMessage: {{count}} items, about {{size}}, will be deleted. This cannot be undone; index rows go with them.

notice.outside_root: Outside the library root; save the library path again: {{path}}
notice.work_dir_is_root: This folder is the library root; deleting it is not offered
notice.work_dir_multiple: The folder holds {{count}} indexed media files; deleting it is not offered: {{path}}
notice.template_error: Template cannot be resolved; products were left out: {{path}} ({{detail}})

cleanup.confirmMessage_one: {{count}} items, about {{size}}, will be deleted. This cannot be undone; index rows go with them.
cleanup.confirmMessage_other: {{count}} items, about {{size}}, will be deleted. This cannot be undone; index rows go with them.
cleanup.scanningHint: You can close this panel; the scan keeps running
cleanup.symlinkHint: Deletes the link inside the library, not the file it points to
cleanup.blocked_one: {{count}} more folder was left out: unrecognized files
cleanup.blocked_other: {{count}} more folders were left out: unrecognized files
cleanup.noiseHint: Created by the OS or a sync tool; deleted along with the folder
cleanup.blocked: {{count}} more folders were left out: unrecognized files

watchEnabled.title: Watch directory
watchEnabled.label: Watch directory
watchEnabled.hint: The library path switches to in-place mode: watch and scrape only, no moving or renaming; set a download directory to pull new files in

watchPath.label: Download directory
watchPath.hint: Leave empty for in-place mode on the library path; when set, new files here are scraped and placed into the target directory using the library's move mode

watchRename.label: Allow in-place rename
watchRename.hint: Whether files already in the target directory get renamed by the template, without moving them

fieldUseJinjaHint: Use Jinja2 syntax for the video path; the template above is disabled. Placeholders keep their names; conditionals look like {% if cd %}-CD{{ cd }}{% endif %}.
fieldJinjaVideoTemplateHint: Used when a watch directory is enabled. Jinja2 syntax, see https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/3.0.x/templates
